answer: Start with Licensed meter reader record with energy supplier attestation. The idea is simple: rounds the supplier recorded across years of readers, and that walnut alone separates one real agent from a hundred fakes. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that rounds the supplier recorded across years of readers — so privacy survives, and the signal is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the garden for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
